list.title: Users
list.description: Accounts only. Trips, chats, and bookings are never visible from here.
list.empty_body: Accounts appear here as soon as somebody signs up.

detail.description: View this account and manage its access.
detail.title: Account details
detail.closed_notice: The owner deleted this account. Its details have been anonymised and it can no longer be changed.

actions.title: Manage access
actions.body: Both actions take effect immediately and sign this account out of every device.

status_action.enable_confirm_body: The owner will be able to sign in again. Sessions that were ended are not restored, so they will need to sign in.
status_action.disable_confirm_body: The owner is signed out of every device straight away and cannot sign in again until you enable the account.
status_action.disabled_success: The account is disabled and every session has ended.

reset.title: Reset the password for {email}
reset.body: Choose a temporary password for {email} and pass it on yourself — by phone, or in person.
reset.warning: The password is never emailed and cannot be read back later. Every session for this account ends immediately.
reset.success_body: Every session for {email} has ended. Give them the temporary password you just chose.
reset.validation_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.unavailable_provider_only: This account signs in through Google or GitHub and has no password to reset.
